### 1 of 1. 2 unused import lines in the widget files can go

### What was found
Two lines that bring in a name from another file are never used. They are at src/widgets/render.ts line 2 and src/widgets/format.ts line 3. Both are in lines this pull request changed.

The project's rule is to remove imported names, variables and modules that nothing uses. Unused lines make a file harder to read and suggest a dependency that does not exist. The rule comes from the Code section of the housekeeping base rules.

### What happens if you accept
Both import lines are deleted, and nothing else in either file changes. You get one new commit on the pull request's branch, feature/widget-colors, which is pushed to the existing pull request.

Pick one:
1. [ ] Fix - Make one commit for this class and push it to the existing PR branch. [recommended]
2. [ ] Ignore - leave them as they are
